Surrounding elements: large text 'PRE-ORDER GEL TẮM BÍ ĐAO', subheadline 'CẢI TIẾN VƯỢT TRỘI', benefits 'SẠCH BÃ NHỜN' and 'GIẢM MỤN & MÙI CƠ THỂ', a PET recycling badge, and a pale yellow circle reading 'MUA 6 TÍNH 1'. Keep the sensual skincare framing, warm natural light, and realistic skin texture. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle beauty photography, golden natural sunlight, warm skin highlights and glossy water droplets, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
